what: The merge-throughput tick decision node (node_throughput_tick_decision_compute) the tick's tests run in process through tests/onex_node_double.py, at the head of the omnimarket pull request that adds its per-repository status check (OMN-19998; the old node rejects the repo_status facts). The tick itself calls the deployed node through onex node; CI fetches exactly these files at this commit: the node's decision handler and model (not its runtime-tick handler, which needs omnibase_infra, nor the handlers/__init__.py that imports it), the pr-land fallback rules and models the decision handler imports, and the PR state and landing state files those import. omnimarket/events and the node's handlers are left without an __init__.py, so they load as namespace packages and the events package's eager imports (which need omnibase_compat) never run.
